notes: The ground this area owns: the strip between the railway and the buildings north of the south-west area, with Carlisle Road from the south-west area's cut to the north edge of the evidence, its roadside parking (Lot 30S, Lot 30), the mouth of Webster Road, and the junction of College Avenue and Carlisle Road beside the Red Hawk Deck (with Lot 33). South: the south-west footprint's north edge, from 3.3 m east of the ballast (on its run (-429, -59.5)-(-408.5, -57.5)) to (-396, -57.5); east of that the two areas do not touch: the Maintenance Building stands between them. East: 1 m outside the walls of the Maintenance Building (west wall, north wall and its notch, from the published tiles); then along the main model's paving (WS74 cogeneration-plant lot, KY_college_ave_asphalt, the KX drive apron) 0.2 m inside its real edge, traced from the tiles' triangles (WS74 west edge and north-west chamfer, its north edge at y -47.0 with a step round the hole at its first stair, KY's west edge, KY's north edge west part run under its notch, a jog to its east part, its dip at the apron, the apron's west edge), so that their asphalt covers the joint and no strip of old ground is left between; then back west 0.2 m outside the Red Hawk Deck's south face, so the paving runs to its foot; round the University Police building and its terrace 1 m out (they stay with the north model, and so does the lawn strip along the deck's west side, ge_deckbase); north past the end of the deck base to 1.4 m west of the field's south-west light pole, then 1 m outside the west edge of Pittser Field's turf and fence, and round the north-west light pole. North-east (widened in the fix-up pass, zone w_webster): about 1 m outside the south-east walk of Webster Road, down the west side of the Feliciano drop-off loop, east along Feliciano's north wall 0.9 to 1.1 m out, then 0.5 m inside University Hall's west walls from the lot (y 223) round the lawn north of it to the end of the plaza (y 278), so the supersede clip takes all of the main model's ground in front of the wall there (1.3 to 2.9 m above the LiDAR ground) and this area's ground runs under the wall, hidden by the building (see free_edges), and 0.2 to 0.35 m off the walls elsewhere, where that ground agrees with ours within 0.5 m (walls from the published tiles; the evidence ortho was fetched again to x -170 for the lot's east end), across Webster Road at right angles just past University Hall's north-west corner (1.5 m from building 313028541), and back south-west along Webster's north-west edge (v +5.3 to +13.5 of its centre arc), so the wooded wedge between Webster Road and Lot 30 stays with the north model; then 1 m outside the walk along Lot 30. North: straight across the road at right angles 436 m along Carlisle Road's centre arc (y 331..344), just inside the edge of the ortho (y 350): the road and Lot 30 run on north of the evidence, so the cut is where they leave it. West: 3.2 to 4.3 m east of the ballast's east edge (measured from the published tiles), straight runs between points 3.6 m off the edge. No vertex lies inside a building, a stand, the turf or a light pole base.

free_edges.why: University Hall (north model): the main model's ground beside and under its west wall (Terrain_LiDAR_DTM_1m_pf, WS60_terrain_edge_apron) stands 1.3 to 2.9 m above the LiDAR ground (edge samples 136.3-137.3 m beside the lot and 136.6-136.75 m beside the plaza, against LiDAR 134.7-135.1 m and the lot at 134.4-134.9 m; the wall base is 134.51 m). The edge runs 0.5 m inside the wall there, so that ground is clipped and hidden; the edge follows this area's own grade instead of building a 2 m bank face in front of the wall.

The widened north-east part adds (m2 inside it, from a dump of the published tiles): PK_Feliciano_west_DTM_fill 2270, Terrain_LiDAR_DTM_1m_pf 1600, WS60_terrain_edge_apron 1300, M3a 1470, North_terrain_LiDAR_1m 354, the skirt 5480, and the flat strips Roads_OSM 363 (the old partial loop) and Footpaths_OSM 91: Terrain_LiDAR_DTM_1m_pf, Roads_OSM and Footpaths_OSM are clipped too (clip, not drop: Roads_OSM runs on beyond the outline). The main model's trees there stay. BD_farfield_3DEP and far_houses have nothing inside. drop: nothing; KY_college_ave_asphalt and WS74_cogen_lot_asphalt are not redrawn: the outline reaches 0.2 m into them (16 and 8 m2) so their asphalt covers the joint.
